#| label: setup

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(patchwork)

source("02_plot_results.R")

dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
out <- function(filename) file.path("plots", filename)

## Setting 1

```{r}
exp1 <- read.csv("exp1/final/exp1_results.csv")
agg1 <- aggregate_exp1(exp1)

cate_lab <- function(scenario) {
  factor(
    ifelse(grepl("nonlinear", scenario), "Non-linear", "Linear"),
    levels = c("Linear", "Non-linear")
  )
}

exp1_block <- function(d, x, col_labs, x_lab, x_breaks, right_strip) {
  d$cate <- cate_lab(d$scenario)
  d$col <- factor(col_labs[sub("_.*", "", d$scenario)], levels = unique(col_labs))
  ggplot(d, aes(.data[[x]], median_mse_mean, colour = method, shape = method)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    facet_grid2(
      cate ~ col,
      scales = "free_y",
      independent = "y",
      axes = "x",
      remove_labels = "x",
      labeller = labeller(cate = label_value, col = label_parsed)
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    theme(strip.text.y = if (right_strip) element_text() else element_blank())
}

exp1_size <- exp1_block(
  filter(agg1, baseline),
  "ssize",
  c(LD = "atop('Low-dim,', Delta==1)", HD = "atop('High-dim,', Delta==5)"),
  expression("Trial size " * n[1]),
  seq(500, 2500, 1000),
  right_strip = FALSE
)
exp1_overlap <- exp1_block(
  filter(agg1, ssize == 1000, grepl("^HD", scenario)),
  "delta",
  c(HD = "atop('High-dim,', n[1]==1000)"),
  expression(Delta == "|" * X[S] * "\\" * X[tau] * "|"),
  5:10,
  right_strip = TRUE
)

exp1_combined <- (y_axis_title("Median squared error") | exp1_size | exp1_overlap) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.04, 2, 1), guides = "collect") &
  paper_text &
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.88,
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm")
  )
ggsave(out("exp1_fig1_2_combined.pdf"), exp1_combined, width = 7.5, height = 5.3)
```

```{r}
exp1_conformal <- plot_exp1_interval_width(agg1)
exp1_conformal$data <- exp1_conformal$data |>
  mutate(
    dim_lab = factor(
      ifelse(grepl("^LD", scenario), "'Low-dim,'~Delta==1", "'High-dim,'~Delta==5"),
      levels = c("'Low-dim,'~Delta==1", "'High-dim,'~Delta==5")
    ),
    cate_lab = cate_lab(scenario),
    conformal_label = factor(conformal_label, levels = c("Naive", "Inexact"))
  )
exp1_conformal <- exp1_conformal +
  aes(shape = method) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes) +
  facet_nested(
    conformal_label ~ dim_lab + cate_lab,
    scales = "free_y",
    axes = "all",
    remove_labels = "all",
    nest_line = element_line(),
    labeller = labeller(dim_lab = label_parsed, cate_lab = label_value)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(500, 2500, 1000)) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Trial size " * n[1]),
    y = "Average interval width",
    colour = NULL,
    shape = NULL,
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  guides(linetype = "none") +
  paper_text +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6, legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"))
ggsave(out("exp1_fig5.pdf"), exp1_conformal, width = 10, height = 4.5)

invisible(make_coverage_table(agg1, output_path = out("exp1_coverage_table.tex")))
invisible(make_coverage_table(
  agg1,
  output_path = out("exp1_coverage_table_ite.tex"),
  ite = TRUE
))
```

## Setting 2

```{r}
exp2 <- read.csv("exp2/final/exp2_results.csv")
agg2 <- aggregate_exp2(exp2)

exp2_prog <- plot_exp2_prognostic(agg2, "median_mse_mean")
exp2_size <- plot_exp2_trial_size(agg2, "median_mse_mean")

split_panel_label <- function(p) {
  add <- function(d) {
    if (!is.data.frame(d) || !"panel_label" %in% names(d)) return(d)
    d$dim_lab <- factor(sub(":.*", "", d$panel_label), levels = c("Low-Dim", "High-Dim"))
    d$out_lab <- factor(
      sub(".*: ", "", d$panel_label),
      levels = c("Linear Outcome", "Non-Linear Outcome")
    )
    d
  }
  p$data <- add(p$data)
  for (l in p$layers) l$data <- add(l$data)
  p
}

exp2_prog_row <- as_grid_row(
  split_panel_label(exp2_prog) + scale_y_log10(),
  c("dim_lab", "out_lab"),
  c(
    "Low-Dim" = "Low-dim",
    "High-Dim" = "High-dim",
    "Linear Outcome" = "Linear",
    "Non-Linear Outcome" = "Non-linear"
  ),
  "n[1]==1500",
  expression("Additional prognostic covariates " * d[P])
)
exp2_size_row <- as_grid_row(
  exp2_size + scale_y_log10() + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(500, 2500, 1000)),
  "panel_label",
  c(
    "Low-Dim: Linear Outcome" = "Linear",
    "Low-Dim: Non-Linear Outcome" = "Non-linear",
    "High-Dim: Linear Outcome" = "Linear",
    "High-Dim: Non-Linear Outcome" = "Non-linear"
  ),
  "d[P]==4",
  expression("Trial size " * n[1])
)

exp2_combined <- (y_axis_title("Median squared error (log scale)") | (exp2_prog_row / exp2_size_row)) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.03, 1), guides = "collect") &
  paper_text &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"))
ggsave(out("exp2_fig1_combined_logy.pdf"), exp2_combined, width = 10, height = 6.8)
```

## Setting 3

```{r}
exp3 <- read.csv("exp3/final/exp3_results.csv")
agg3 <- aggregate_exp3(exp3)

exp3_block <- function(p, fixed, x_lab) {
  p$data$fixed <- fixed
  p +
    facet_nested(
      cols = vars(fixed, scenario_label),
      scales = "free_y",
      independent = "y",
      nest_line = element_line(),
      labeller = labeller(
        fixed = label_parsed,
        scenario_label = as_labeller(c(
          "Low-Dim: Non-Linear CATE" = "Low-dim",
          "High-Dim: Non-Linear CATE" = "High-dim"
        ))
      )
    ) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = NULL, colour = NULL, linetype = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())
}

exp3_subsample <- exp3_block(
  plot_exp3_subsample_size(agg3, "median_mse_mean") +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(500, 2000, 10000), labels = c("500", "2K", "10K")),
  "n[1]==2000",
  expression("Subsample size " * n[sub] * " (log scale)")
)
exp3_trial <- exp3_block(
  plot_exp3_trial_size(agg3, "median_mse_mean") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(500, 2500, 1000)),
  "n[sub]==5000",
  expression("Trial size " * n[1])
)

exp3_combined <- (y_axis_title("Median squared error") | exp3_subsample | exp3_trial) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.04, 1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  paper_text &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"))
ggsave(out("exp3_summary.pdf"), exp3_combined, width = 9.5, height = 3.95)
```
